$comment: Environment variables this brick depends on. Read by `fonderie env`, the admin console and check:env-declarations — docs/ENV-DECLARATIONS-DESIGN.md

vars.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
vars.description: Bearer token guarding the operator console at /_admin. Unset: those routes are not mounted. Shared by every brick that has an admin surface.

vars.name: ADMIN_OPERATOR_KEY
vars.description: Encrypts operators' TOTP secrets at rest. Exactly 64 hex characters.

vars.name: ADMIN_HOST
vars.description: Hosts the console answers on, comma-separated. Unset: any host.

operators.description: Operator sign-in with email, password and TOTP
